inquiry.subject: Freight options for your shipments
inquiry.body: hi, i run a small farm supply store but we also have a little freight brokerage on the side that moves pallets of equipment around the region. wondering if you ever need a second carrier for deliveries to dealers in the midwest, our rates are competitive. can i send over a rate sheet and who would i send it to? thanks, Wes Kowalczyk, Kowalczyk Farm Supply & Freight

retrieved.title: Freight Damage and Shipment Discrepancy Claims
retrieved.heading: Who this applies to
retrieved.text: This process is for dealers and distributors that receive pallet shipments from Fernhollow. It covers freight damage, wrong items, and short quantities.

retrieved.title: Returns and Damaged-on-Arrival Policy for Customers
retrieved.heading: Who this policy is for
retrieved.text: This policy is for people who bought a Fernhollow machine directly from Fernhollow. If you bought from a dealer, contact the dealer. Dealers and distributors should use the Partner Defect Report Procedure.

retrieved.title: Partner Defect Report Procedure
retrieved.heading: Who this procedure is for
retrieved.text: This procedure is for Fernhollow dealers and distributors. Use it to report a defect that you see on one or more Fernhollow units. Customers who bought direct should use the returns policy.
